facts.fact: Jembi states that health facilities in Inhambane Province use the birth module of e-SiRCEV, the electronic civil registration and vital statistics system, and that its link to the hospital births module was launched on 22 July 2024; deaths are not mentioned.

Jembi states that five health facilities in Inhambane Province used the e-SiRCEV birth module, a number the interoperability project begun there in April and May 2024 was to raise to nineteen; these are health facilities in one province, no national count of offices is given.
